function.name: investigation_return
function.description: Bounded evidence report

scope.description: Exact inspected source fields declaring applicability, e.g. result_type, execution_id, or prediction scope.
scope.title: Scope

support_explanation.description: Principal explanation linking these facts to this claim; semantic correctness remains unassessed.
support_explanation.title: Support Explanation

evidence.description: Finite authorized source scope; metadata is paged, never all bodies prefetched.
evidence.title: Evidence

reference.description: Existing immutable evidence reference, not a node_id. A build has no evaluation or trajectory to read.

pointer.description: JSON Pointer into original evidence, e.g. /detail or /signals/0/values. Empty reads the root. Oversized nested content returns a labeled overview with valid child pointers; follow those pointers using the same source reference.
pointer.title: Pointer

byte_limit.description: Requested content byte cap; response and observation envelopes also count toward the inline limit. Pages may be smaller. Follow next_offset at the same pointer.
byte_limit.title: Byte Limit

source_identity.description: Optional exact identity fields carried by the original source, never current-candidate attribution.
source_identity.title: Source Identity

dispositions.description: Principal-only explicit structured decisions; the runner submits them through the public disposition tool.
dispositions.title: Dispositions

pointer.description: JSON Pointer into original evidence, e.g. /detail or /signals/0/values. Empty reads the root. Oversized nested content returns a labeled overview with valid child pointers; follow those pointers using the same source reference.

byte_limit.title: Byte Limit

arguments.title: ReadEvidence
arguments.description: Only the selected tool domain fields belong here. Required: reference. Do not include nested reason; reason belongs only in the outer envelope.

reason.description: Required outer transport metadata: an English explanation for requesting this tool. A nested arguments.reason does not supply this field.
reason.title: Reason

evidence.description: Optional outer transport evidence references. Route citations belong separately in arguments.evidence when required by the route schema.
evidence.title: Evidence

tool_version.description: Required outer transport metadata: exactly the version declared for this tool.
tool_version.title: Tool Version

parameters.title: ToolEnvelope

scope.description: Exact inspected source fields declaring applicability, e.g. result_type, execution_id, or prediction scope.

support_explanation.description: Principal explanation linking these facts to this claim; semantic correctness remains unassessed.

reference.description: Existing immutable evidence reference, not a node_id. A build has no evaluation or trajectory to read.

source_identity.description: Optional exact identity fields carried by the original source, never current-candidate attribution.

dispositions.description: Principal-only explicit structured decisions; the runner submits them through the public disposition tool.

function.description: Bounded evidence report
function.name: investigation_return

scope.description: Exact inspected source fields declaring applicability, e.g. result_type, execution_id, or prediction scope.
scope.title: Scope

support_explanation.description: Principal explanation linking these facts to this claim; semantic correctness remains unassessed.
support_explanation.title: Support Explanation

evidence.description: Finite authorized source scope; metadata is paged, never all bodies prefetched.
evidence.title: Evidence

byte_limit.description: Requested content byte cap; response and observation envelopes also count toward the inline limit. Pages may be smaller. Follow next_offset at the same pointer.
byte_limit.title: Byte Limit

pointer.description: JSON Pointer into original evidence, e.g. /detail or /signals/0/values. Empty reads the root. Oversized nested content returns a labeled overview with valid child pointers; follow those pointers using the same source reference.
pointer.title: Pointer

reference.description: Existing immutable evidence reference, not a node_id. A build has no evaluation or trajectory to read.

source_identity.description: Optional exact identity fields carried by the original source, never current-candidate attribution.
source_identity.title: Source Identity

dispositions.description: Principal-only explicit structured decisions; the runner submits them through the public disposition tool.
